Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the metering of permit exempt wells.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to metering permit exempt wells; and adding a newsection to chapter 90.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department may not require withdrawals of groundwater to bemetered or measured for wells authorized under the provisions of RCW90.44.050 constructed prior to the effective date of this section forsingle or group domestic uses that do not exceed withdrawing fivethousand gallons a day. (2) This section does not apply to wells the department hasrequired to be metered or measured as of the effective date of thissection.
